verdict.rationale: Clerk is an auth and user-management platform, and it does not document its own automation or workflow engine. What it offers are building blocks: webhooks push events such as user created or updated to your handler, and API keys and M2M tokens authenticate background agents calling each other. You would have to host and run the actual automations yourself. Missing for 10: a native automation or scheduled-job feature, autonomous background execution hosted by Clerk, and independent or hands-on evidence of automation workflows.
